Introduction
Maternal nutrition during pregnancy is a critical public health priority across the globe. The ﬁrst 1000 days, starting at concep-
tion, marks a time period of enormous potential but also vulnerability. Inability to meet nutrient requirements during pregnancy
can have serious short- and long-term effects on maternal and child health and development (Victora et al., 2021). Indeed, it is
